points.description: States that the slightly different salt concentration still falls within the range of tolerance in which brine shrimp eggs can hatch (equivalent wording such as 'the eggs can tolerate a small change in salinity' earns the mark).

rubric.notes: Full mark for explaining that the slightly different salt solution is still within the eggs' tolerance range so hatching still occurs. No partial credit, since the model answer is a single idea; an answer that only says the salt amount was 'about right' without linking it to tolerance or range should be judged on whether the core idea is present.
